target_segments: Measurable hepatic lesion or measurable nodal lesion, in either case confirmed on contrast-enhanced imaging.

text_span: in either case confirmed on contrast-enhanced imaging
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: hepatic lesion and nodal lesion are distinct screening targets. The measurability and imaging-confirmation requirements apply to either target; the explicitly shared confirmation qualifier is retained with this branch (X2).

text_span: measurable nodal lesion, in either case confirmed on contrast-enhanced imaging
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: nodal lesion is independently evaluable from hepatic lesion. The shared imaging-confirmation qualifier applies to this alternative as indicated by 'in either case' (X2).
